XezobBFsj6Q.caveat: TITLES ONLY — do NOT read this set's precision as a real figure. Its chapter times are ~1.35x ahead of its own audio ("Da Funk" is charted at 60:05 and is actually audible at 40:09; "We Come One" at 24:24 vs 16:49), and 5 of the 13 chapters are never heard at all, so the list was evidently written for a different edit of this mix. A row we report that is absent from these 13 is therefore just as likely to be a track the list mistimed or omitted as a mistake. Kept because the titles are real and it is the only loop-ambiguous techno set in the corpus.
